most_likely_actual_diagnosis_free_text: Acute DIC with shock triggered by povidone-iodine instilled under pressure through the nephrostomy (pyelovenous backflow causing systemic iodine absorption, possibly with endotoxemia or bacteremia)
one_line_reason: Rigors began within minutes of povidone-iodine instilled under pressure into the renal pelvis, before any transfusion, and were followed by diffuse raw-surface oozing, ecchymoses, refractory hypotension, raised INR/aPTT, falling platelets and severe anemia: a consumptive coagulopathy (DIC) from pyelovenous backflow.
